author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಸದ್ದಿರದೆ ನಿಸ್ಪೃಹದಿ ರವಿಶಶಿಯು ದುಡಿದಿಹರು
ಗದ್ದಲವೆ ಇಲ್ಲದೆಯೆ ಚಿಗುರೊಡೆಯೆ ಫಲವು
ಸುದ್ದಿಗಿಂಬಿಲ್ಲದಿಹ ಕೆಲಸಗಳ ಮಾಡುತಿರೆ
ಶುದ್ಧಕಾಯಕ ಯೋಗಿ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Without a sound, without desire, the sun and moon keep working;
without any fuss, the fruit sprouts from the bud;
if you keep doing work that makes no news,
you are a yogi of pure work, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: The sun and moon do their work silently and without reward; fruit ripens without fanfare. Work done quietly, not for recognition, is a true yoga of action.
